# Original Nivo border-color reference

The producer executes the pinned original Nivo0.99.0 inherited-color generator and hook, the original Bar hook and grouped/stacked generators, HeatMap computeCells/useCellsStyle, and the original Bar/HeatMap Canvas function bodies. It reuses the existing original source fixtures and full Nivo/D3 licenses already present in this project. New original files are unmodified under vendor, with exact hashes and upstream paths in vendor/source-pins.json.

    node scripts/border-color-role-reference.mjs <scale-color-node_modules> <shape-node_modules> --check

Provide existing d3-scale4.0.2, d3-interpolate3.0.1, d3-array3.2.5, d3-color3.1.0 and d3-shape3.2.0 modules. No dependency installation is performed. The producer uses each existing package's declared module entry (including dist-only releases) and pins the entries and selected implementation files. Without --check it regenerates values.json/reference.json. --reference-root selects existing shared project fixtures when reproducing from a standalone source stage; the default is the project containing this script.

42 frozen shared cases are replayed through the complete original resolver, not a handwritten modifier loop.36 ordinary cases agree with numeric RGB construction; six preserve the real CSS-alpha-zero parser boundary. The source CSS rgba(9,8,7,0) loses RGB when parsed by original d3.rgb; later opacity1 can therefore reveal black while typed Rust preserves9,8,7. Neither result is rewritten. Actual returned numeric CSS is decoded directly for fixture bytes, without a second CSS parse that would itself discard hidden RGB.

72 Bar records come from the actual original useBar result, grouped/stacked and vertical/horizontal, using six default/inherited/darker/ordered/fixed/theme profiles. The data series named color is deliberately numeric. The real outer ComputedBar.color is a CSS palette string. Native filterNullValues removes rawData.color when zero, while data.value still retains zero; records preserve that fact rather than fabricating a source object. Null bars are generated by upstream but filtered by its original barsWithValue before border resolution, matching the original SVG/Canvas call sites.

36 HeatMap records use actual computeCells and useCellsStyle for0,10,explicitnull with empty and active-null snapshots. Source palette/emptyColor are assigned before border resolution, and base/active/inactive opacity is separate from border RGBA. All288 renderer invocations run original functions against an explicit recording context, for borderWidth0/2 and Rect/Circle. This proves function/control flow and command fields, not native Canvas pixels or browser rendering. Labels are disabled; unexpected text calls throw.

React hooks use immediate snapshot adapters, not React scheduling/lifecycle. Source property lookup covers only the supplied flat/dotted own-data paths, not full lodash syntax. Palette adapters accept explicit functions; String formatting is used for these inputs. Theme paths and custom-function identity are original native features, while Rust Theme maps to the configured border fallback and Contrast is a checked Rust extension. Four original creation errors are retained. Hidden/cropped/preflight/factory transaction behavior is tested separately in Rust.

The portable Rust test compares the72 ordinary Bar and36 HeatMap border outputs/active opacity to these executed native values. It requires geojson for serde_json and does not claim standalone widgets, full geometry equivalence or arbitrary custom accessor compatibility. This reference does not change original Rust defaults or enable absent borders.
